To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a novel system for 3D localization of a person using a monocular camera on a quadrotoring MAV.

a monocular RGB camera on a quadrotors MAV is sufficient to localize a walking person within an area of several hundred square meters, with an absolute metric scale and with an accuracy of a few meters, in real time, without requiring any external infrastructure.

(1) a person can be automatically detected in the monocular camera image and tracked in 3D using a single camera onboard a quadrotor MAV, (2) the person's height is estimated from the camera image, and (3) the trajectory of the person can be estimated with respect to the reconstructed 3D map of the environment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the problem of localizing a moving person onboard an MAV.
the development of autonomous systems for the inspection of large indoor and outdoor environments, where the human operator can be tracked and monitored.
the development of a system that enables MAVs to autonomously track a person and reconstruct the person’s 3D trajectory.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
our system can track a person for a long time (2 mins) over a large area (140 meters) with a small and low power computer running onboard the UAV.
the proposed approach is able to estimate the 3D position of a person moving in an environment with respect to a MAV.
we present a novel system that can localize a moving person from monocular video onboard a quadrotor MAV.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated a complete system for monocular localization of a moving person in 3D using a quadrotor MAV.
we can now localize a moving person in 3D using a monocular camera onboard an autonomous MAV.
we are the first to present a system that can track and localize a person from an aerial platform in real time.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a monocular camera can be used to recover a person's 3D trajectory in an efficient way, even when the person is moving and occluding itself.
a MAV can be used as a mobile platform to track a moving person in an unknown environment, which can be useful in many applications such as surveillance and rescue operations.
a monocular camera onboard a MAV can be used to track a person and estimate the trajectory of the person in 3D.
